evidence.quote: They both fell to the ground, trying desperately to take the vests off.
"This vest won't come off!" cried the pig.

answers.rationale: 八戒和悟净都无法脱下丝绸背心，所以 A 为真；寺院里没有和尚做饭，唐僧也明确拒绝穿偷来的背心。

evidence.quote: The monk glared at him.
"You must return those vests right away!"

answers.rationale: 唐僧命令八戒归还背心；他没有让八戒做饭或寻找悟空。

evidence.quote: "Who stole my vests?" a voice shouted.
A demon with one big horn rushed over.

answers.rationale: 出现的妖怪只有一只大角；原文没有两只大鼻子或三条大胳膊。

evidence.quote: He lifted his sleeve, revealing a metal ring around his arm.

answers.rationale: 独角兕从袖子下露出戴在手臂上的金属圈，因此 A 为真；偷背心的是八戒而非唐僧，八戒也没有秘密武器。

evidence.quote: The demon's smirk disappeared.
The demon sounded nervous.
Once he was away from the others though, he grew worried again.

answers.rationale: 独角兕听到悟空身份后表面嘴硬，独处时却再次担忧，真实感受是紧张；不是毫不害怕或开心。

evidence.quote: The guard sent a messenger to see if any spirits were missing from Heaven.
"Nobody is missing from Heaven. But I will arrest One-Horned Buffalo for you."

answers.rationale: 天庭核查后明确无人失踪，说明独角兕不是从天庭逃走；武士也未能逮捕他，悟空上天是调查身份而不是取回铁棒。

evidence.quote: "Send a fire god to Earth with these two."
"Send a thunder god with them this time."

answers.rationale: 玉帝先后增派火神和雷神，没有派水神；因此未派的是 A，而火神、雷神两项都在原文出现。

evidence.quote: "If you don't come with me, I'll have to—" One-Horned Buffalo held up the metal ring, and . . . whoosh! The warrior's sword flew into it.
The spear was gone.
One-Horned Buffalo held up the metal ring and—whoosh! The thunderbolt was gone.
"Thank you for all the weapons!"

answers.rationale: 独角兕每轮都用金属圈吸走来援者的武器，并称谢这些武器；他没有投掷雷电或飞去天庭。

evidence.quote: The messenger returned quickly with a warrior.
The warrior held a large sword.

answers.rationale: 天庭武士手持大剑；长矛属于后来火神，金属圈属于独角兕。

evidence.quote: "He once stole all the peaches from the Royal Peach Garden."
Wukong bit the demon's arm again and again.
But he didn't take off the metal ring.

answers.rationale: 原文说悟空过去偷的是御桃园仙桃，并非独角兕的桃；本集他确实咬独角兕手臂，而独角兕始终没有摘下金属圈，因此 A 是唯一不真实项。

evidence.quote: The monkey turned himself into a tiny bug and flew into the cave.

answers.rationale: 悟空变成小虫飞进山洞；他没有破门，也没有爬窗。

evidence.quote: Laozi nodded. "He's my green buffalo. I didn't realize he'd escaped."
The demon pulled off the metal ring and flung it at Laozi.
Laozi tucked the fan and the ring into his robe.

answers.rationale: 老子确认独角兕是自己逃走的青牛，所以 A 为真；八戒没有在城市失踪，金属圈也是老子接住并收回而非悟空拿走。

evidence.quote: Wukong entered the monastery and bowed before Buddha.
"I know why you're here, Wukong. I also know who the demon is. You must go to Laozi for help."

answers.rationale: 佛祖明确让悟空去找老子；不是去找独角兕或玉帝。

evidence.quote: "That woman stabbed me in the head," moaned Wukong.
There was no injury.
It was Guanyin.
"Beware of that scorpion spirit!"

answers.rationale: 被刺头的是悟空而非悟净，且悟空头上确实没有伤口；观音又明确称女子为蝎子精，因此 A 是唯一不真实项。

evidence.quote: Suddenly he felt a stabbing pain.
"That woman stabbed me in the head," moaned Wukong.

answers.rationale: 妖怪用毒刺刺中悟空的头；她没有夺铁棒，也不是用咒语使他疼痛。

evidence.quote: Suddenly Bajie cried out, "Ahh!"
He covered his nose and ran back down the mountain.
"She stabbed my nose!"

answers.rationale: 八戒被刺的是鼻子；不是头或肚子。

evidence.quote: A voice called out, "Wait!"
It was Guanyin.

answers.rationale: 叫住众人的声音来自观音；不是佛祖或唐僧。

evidence.quote: "I won't go near her," said Guanyin.

"Even Buddha is afraid of her. He was teaching his students one day and saw that scorpion creeping toward him. He tried to move it away, but it stung him. The pain was horrible! He told his guards to capture the scorpion. But it escaped to Earth."
Bajie walked over to the Star Lord, who then blew on the pig's nose.
Suddenly the Star Lord turned into an enormous rooster.
In her place was a dead scorpion.

answers.rationale: 观音明确说连佛祖也怕蝎子精；治好八戒的是星官，最终把蝎子变为死蝎的也是星官化成的大公鸡，而非观音或悟空。

evidence.quote: "Wukong," said the Star Lord. "What can I do for you?"
"I'm traveling to the Western Paradise with the Tang Monk. But he was captured by a demon. Guanyin said you can help me."

answers.rationale: 悟空向星官请求帮助，并说明是观音让他来；他并非向观音或佛祖提出这次求援。

evidence.quote: He found the Tang Monk sitting at a table.
"That woman didn't want to harm me—she wanted to marry me!"

answers.rationale: 唐僧明确说女子绑他是想嫁给他；她不是想吃他或伤害他。

evidence.quote: Wukong laughed.
"Master, I don't know why you're still going there. You should have married that scorpion spirit instead!"
"I agree with Wukong," said Bajie.
Everybody laughed, including Bajie.

answers.rationale: 众人围绕唐僧本可娶蝎子精、八戒也愿意娶她的玩笑发笑；停村和对付恶汉都不是笑点。

evidence.quote: "Let's make a bet then," said Wukong.
"If you can pick this up, we'll give you all of our money."

answers.rationale: 悟空赌持斧男子举不起铁棒；赌注不是拿走所有钱，也不是找到西天。

evidence.quote: He lifted the bar over his head and twirled it around.
He got ready to strike the man.

answers.rationale: 悟空举起铁棒准备击打男子；他没有准备偷斧头或绑架对方。

evidence.quote: "You're still evil, Wukong. I can't bring you to the Western Paradise. You must leave."
"Go!" said the Tang Monk.

answers.rationale: 唐僧认定悟空仍有恶性，命令他离开；不是留下同行，也不是去找食物。

evidence.quote: The monk sat down in the grass next to the road and closed his eyes.
Before the monk could recite the spell, Wukong struck. Whap! He knocked out the monk.
"We can't let him get away with this! He probably went home, to the Fruit and Flower Mountain."
When Wujing arrived there, he found Wukong near the waterfall.
A monk who looked exactly like the Tang Monk sat on a horse.

answers.rationale: 唐僧是在花果山之外的路边休息时遭猴子击昏；悟净后来才到花果山，并在那里听悟空说不认识他、看到假唐僧等同伴，所以按题干地点，A 是花果山没有发生的事。

evidence.quote: "Don't cry, Wukong," said Guanyin.
"You will still help the Tang Monk reach the Western Paradise. He will need your help soon. In the meantime you may stay here with me."

answers.rationale: 观音让悟空暂时留在普陀山等唐僧再次需要他；她没有叫他去向唐僧求饶或返回花果山。

evidence.quote: "We're out of rice," said the pig.
"Master, you wait here while Bajie and I find a village."

answers.rationale: 悟净和八戒发现没米后一起去找村庄乞食；不是找观音或讨钱。

evidence.quote: Before the monk could recite the spell, Wukong struck. Whap! He knocked out the monk.
Quickly, the monkey grabbed the bags and then vanished.

answers.rationale: 猴子击昏唐僧后迅速拿走行李；没有拿马或紧箍。

evidence.quote: "I'll go there and deal with him," said Wujing.
When Wujing arrived there, he found Wukong near the waterfall.

answers.rationale: 悟净明确前往并抵达花果山；八戒只提供路线，观音也没有去。
